items.q: But Budd Johnson worked with us occasionally too with Roy's band.

ctx.x: He was quite a guy. But Budd Johnson worked with us occasionally too with Roy's band. Budd Johnson and Zutty and it was just a pleasure working with Budd also because Budd was such a tremendous saxophone player, as I told you before. And all of these guys came from Oklahoma or Texas or somewhere, I don't know. The midwest just had
good musicians, very good swing musicians. And -- because let's see -- pardon?
